source: Schwartz MH, Rozumalski A, Trost JP (2008). The effect of walking speed on the gait of typically developing children. J Biomech 41(8):1639-1650. Free (self-selected) speed normative curves, mean across subjects, from the author-distributed supplementary spreadsheet (Original- Schwartz2008.xls, author MSchwartz) redistributed in the pyCGM2 open-access normative data collection.
speed_m_s: self-selected 'Free' speed condition; paper reports speeds as nondimensional (v/sqrt(g*Lleg)); absolute m/s not present in the machine-readable supplement, typically ~1.1-1.3 m/s for TD children
angle_convention_note: 'Ankle Dorsi/Plantarflexion' angle, Vicon Plug-in-Gait sagittal ankle angle; dorsiflexion positive (deg). Free-speed mean curve, 51 points at 2% gait-cycle increments (0=ipsilateral foot contact).
moment_convention_note: 'Ankle Dorsi/Plantarflexion' internal joint moment, normalized to body mass (N.m/kg); plantarflexor positive (late-stance push-off peak is positive, ~1.23 N.m/kg at ~48% cycle).
extraction_note: Extracted Free-speed 'mean' column (col J) of sheets 'Joint Rotations' and 'Joint Moments' rows labeled 'Ankle Dorsi/Plantarflexion' from Original-Schwartz2008.xls via xlrd; verified identical (atol 1e-3) to FreeMean in Formatted-Schwartz2008.xlsx and to (lower+upper)/2 of pyCGM2 Schwartz2008.json (moments there in N.mm/kg). No sign flips applied; source conventions already dorsiflexion-positive / plantarflexor-positive.
